problem: Both alternatives inside the non-applicable sh:or contain property shapes without sh:minCount, so they are vacuously valid when the corresponding property is absent. Consequently, the non-applicable branch can validate any ship satisfying only the top-level iceClass and bulbousBowPresent constraints, allowing an IA Super ship without a bulb to bypass the applicable readiness inputs and C1/C2 outputs.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:iceClass property shape in the first non-applicable alternative and to the nltl:bulbousBowPresent property shape in the second alternative, so each alternative is satisfied only when its applicability discriminator is present and matches.
regression_guard: Preserve the non-applicable disjunction: non-IA ice classes or bulbousBowPresent=true may bypass the IA Super/no-bulb readiness requirements, but IA Super with bulbousBowPresent=false must select gen:TRF025ApplicableShape.
